note: Real HTTPS requests against archive.org for the currently published (pre-reorder) comunicacoes.parquet. Covers the 'old file' half of issue #1471/#1472's real Archive read-back proof; the candidate (reordered) file's half needs IA write credentials to publish first.

cors.implication: download_endpoint_cors_enabled=false means a cross-origin browser fetch (DuckDB-WASM's httpfs, as DuckDBExplorer.svelte issues it) cannot read the response body from archive.org's file-download endpoint. Confirmed with curl and Python's urllib against three real archive.org endpoints (this metadata endpoint and advancedsearch.php both send Access-Control-Allow-Origin; the file-download endpoint does not), as a positive control against this environment's forced HTTPS MITM proxy stripping the header uniformly. NOT yet confirmed in a real browser: archive_cors_probe.mjs's Playwright/Chromium check hit net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID against the same proxy's re-terminating CA in this sandbox before it could reach the network layer -- that is this environment's TLS trust configuration, not evidence about archive.org.
